facts.action: 走进第二个试炼室：房间更大，中央有一口巨坑，坑上架着一座摇摇欲坠的木桥，是通往对面那扇门的唯一路径
facts.verbatim: An old, rickety, wooden bridge spanned the distance

facts.action: 四名持剑士兵冲进来后，命令 Felix 立刻过桥，自己转身独面士兵；两人背靠背换位
从掌心凝出两条金色巨蛇般的力量，结成两柄战斧（每手一柄），与四名士兵缠斗，一斧劈断一名士兵的剑
facts.verbatim: Tendrils of gold wove outwards from the centres

facts.action: 掷斧冻结在一名士兵脸前一英寸处，随后召回斧头，把金发士兵钉在墙上（只钉住衬衫，不伤人）
facts.verbatim: impaled the blonde-headed soldier to the wall

facts.action: 桥绳断裂、Felix 悬空坠落的瞬间，抬手凝出金色盾泡把他整个罩住，悬在半空
facts.verbatim: a bright, beaming golden shield encircled Felix entirely

facts.action: 一边硬受四名士兵对她个人护盾的猛击，一边操纵盾泡把 Felix 稳稳移到对岸实地上放下
facts.verbatim: steering the shield bubble over to the safety

facts.action: 竖起横贯两墙的金色盾墙把士兵步步推挤到墙边，并封死门口阻止一名士兵逃跑
facts.verbatim: A bright, translucent golden shield snapped into place

facts.action: 掷出约五英寸宽的盾桥跑过深坑到对岸，握拳让所有护盾瞬间消失；人群雷鸣般欢呼，她已透支到鼻血渗出仍拒绝退出
facts.verbatim: A shield bridge roughly five inches wide appeared

relations: Inara 与 Felix：挚友兼 Charge 关系——Felix 只在为她担心时才叫她 Nara；他奉命先过桥，坠桥时被 Inara 的盾泡救起并护送过岸，事后扶住透支的她、劝她停止（You’re down to your reserves）
Inara 与四名试炼士兵（四人皆持剑、两两分左右包抄）：试炼对手——她压制、逼退并把他们挤到墙边，但刻意不杀；赛前被告知若有伤会有 Healer 待命
Inara 与 Larissa：较劲延续——Larissa 见她凝出双战斧时 mouth dropped open
Inara 与 Prince Walder（The Crowned Prince，紫罗兰色眼睛）：审视——Walder 全神贯注于她并身体前倾，是全场唯一在人群起立时仍保持坐姿的人
High Council 与观众：观赛者——成千上万观众起立鼓掌欢呼；士兵的窘态是 Inara 有意留给所有轻视 Borderlands 的人的警告

four men came barrelling through the door
the four hulking men closing in on her
Taking one step at a time
two terrifying battle axes, one in each hand
He was halfway across the bridge
Two guards stepped to the left, two to the right
one guard from each side attacked
splitting the weapon in two
the two broken pieces of his sword
hovered in the air an inch away from his face
There was not a single doubt about it
Inara was tall, roughly 6’4, but Felix was 6’6, and mostly all muscle
spanning the distance between one wall and the other
One of the soldiers picked up an abandoned sword
the blade snapped in two
A shield bridge roughly five inches wide appeared
through the open door she and Felix had first come through
stepped out onto the first wooden plank
one agonising step at a time
As if one being, they noticed
thousands of eyes upon them
He let her take the first step
本章无日期
